{{Quote|As we speak, the Imps are mounting an attack on Kuat's main defensive control station. Their starfighters have also targeted related assets in Kuati space.|Fleet Admiral [[Bey'wan Aygo|Aygo]]|<ref name="TOR:TSW" />}}
The '''Kuat Defensive Station''' was a space station orbiting [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] in the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. During the [[Galactic War]], [[Asset K-33]] sent a transmission to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Zasha Ranken]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] suggesting that this station was the key to subverting all Kuat Drive Yards security protocols. [[Shroud SF-4]], who had been tracking K-33 went to the station to liberate capital ships for [[The Shroud's syndicate|the Shroud's network]]. K-33 found SF-4 out, and stabbed him in the back with a [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]]. SF-4 managed to transmit his journal entries to [[The Shroud (Human)|The Shroud]] before he [[Death/Legends|died]]. [[Asset SF-5]] was later sent to dispose of SF-4's body and belongings and to observe the [[Battle of Kuat (Galactic War)|Battle of Kuat]] to learn who would be the victor.
